metadata.description: Climate: 186 glaciers with at least five years of field-measured annual mass balance since 2015, colored by their average yearly gain or loss in metres of water equivalent (World Glacier Monitoring Service, Fluctuations of Glaciers database, doi:10.5904/wgms-fog-2026-02-10). Nearly all are shrinking; Alpine glaciers lose more than a metre of ice a year.
